name: Mochi Pet Supply
description: Mochi Pet Supply is a neighbourhood pet-food and supplies shop in Leith, Edinburgh, founded in 2017 and selling online across the UK in pounds. The site starts with three questions — species, age, and one thing to watch — then shows the food and a subscribe-and-save price at 10% off repeat deliveries. Shop, product, cart, checkout, account and order-received pages are set up for WooCommerce and still read as ordinary pages without it.
